title: TryFit
tagline: We Build Your Story of Success
description:
1. The problem in the current world is people have very less time to contribute to their health 
which is what we are focusing on overall health and fitness 

Through the usage of IoT devices like Fitbit we are getting the details like the calories burnt, distance walked, hydration and sleep analysis
the user can choose to live and cultivate an ideal healthy habit which is tracked and rewarded using our platform tokens built on shardeum.

The IoT devices are authorised by user to connect to our Dapp and the lifestyle changes he chooses to do is stored in a contract 
to determine the rewards to be given.

2. There is very little exposure to the common crowd of web3 and hence are reluctant to use it
We by using simple web2 logins and no signature transactions make it easy for the common crowd to use it.
Considering it is a web app it is not a space-consuming app and yet monitors your progress through IoT devices.

3. This platform brings together the potential of IoT usage in the blockchain. Which is hardly considered in many Dapps
how_its_made: Considering the tech provided by bounties is fresh and little crude which interoperability between chains that we used was an issue(we used shardeum)
